- License"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What this plugin does"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"dsh-medomni is a preview implementation of the MedOmni strategy for medical image analysis. It gives"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" a language-model agent a modality-specific set of tools so it can select an appropriate workflow fr"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"om a natural-language request:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Report generation:** Generate candidate reports for chest X-ray, CT, MRI, and retinal images; co"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"mpare current and prior chest X-rays for interval change.
- **Localization:** Ground suspected chest"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" X-ray findings with evidence boxes, locate named chest X-ray findings, and label normal chest X-ray"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" anatomy.
- **Segmentation:** Generate masks and overlays for prompted findings or structures in X-r"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ay, ultrasound, retinal images, CT NIfTI volumes, and MRI NIfTI volumes; perform fixed-label anatomi"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"cal segmentation on CT and MRI volumes.
- **Classification:** Classify ultrasound images to support "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"a classification-first workflow before targeted localization.
- **Agent-guided routing:** Select rep"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"orting, classification, localization, or segmentation tools from a natural-language request and retu"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"rn structured results with preview images.
- **Input handling:** Paste supported 2D images through t"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"he image-enabled provider route or supply them by path. Supply 3D CT/MRI studies by filesystem path;"},{"id":"p11s11","text":" NIfTI is supported by all 3D tools, while DICOM directories are supported by the report and fixed-l"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"abel segmentation tools."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Data and network disclosure:** Model inference runs locally on the configured machine. The plugin "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"connects to Hugging Face to download model checkpoints and uses `HF_TOKEN` only for gated model acce"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ss; the token is read from the process environment and is not stored by the plugin. Input files and "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"generated previews are read from or written to the local filesystem and are retained according to th"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"e surrounding DSH session. The behavior of the selected DSH language-model provider is controlled by"},{"id":"p12s6","text":" DSH and its provider configuration, not by this plugin."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Prepare these items before installing the plugin:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- A DeepSeek Harness `dsh` installation.
- **An NVIDIA GPU with CUDA.** CPU mode is available for so"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"me tools, but these multi-GB vision-language and segmentation models are generally impractical witho"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ut a GPU.
- `uv`, `git`, and Python 3 available on `PATH`. `uv` creates the isolated environment; `g"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"it` is used by BiomedParse on its first use.
- Hugging Face access for the gated checkpoints: accept"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" the terms for MAIRA-2 (`microsoft/maira-2`), BiomedParse (`microsoft/BiomedParse`), and MedGemma. B"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"iomedCLIP is public.
- A Hugging Face read token. Create one at Hugging Face settings, then either r"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"un `hf auth login` or export it with `export HF_TOKEN=hf_...`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"No checkpoint needs to be downloaded manually. The required model downloads automatically when its t"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ool is first used. Optional prefetch commands are documented below."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Follow these steps in order."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### 1.
